title: How To Add A Sidebar To Homepage | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Add A Sidebar To Homepage Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000005307 Brilliant Directories offers a homepage sidebar that displays under the homepage image and divider: Follow these instructions to add the homepage sidebar along with the recent articles widget: 1. Navigate to Settings » Design Settings » Homepage Layout » Homepage Section Order . 2. From the drop-down, select " Show Recent Member Articles with Sidebar " or " Show Recent Blog Articles with Sidebar ": 3. Click " Save Changes ". 4. Click " Edit Settings " for this section and select the desired sidebar from the available options: NOTE: If there are no published articles, the section will appear empty. Additional Information: » Toolbox » Sidebar Manager » How to Create a Sidebar For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
